-- Actions Gemma never picks
SELECT action_id FROM \(
  SELECT DISTINCT action_id FROM labels WHERE teacher != 'lmstudio_google_gemma-3-12b'
\) WHERE action_id NOT IN \(
  SELECT DISTINCT action_id FROM labels WHERE teacher = 'lmstudio_google_gemma-3-12b'
\);
-- Confidence distribution buckets for Gemma
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN confidence < 0.7 THEN '<0.70'
    WHEN confidence < 0.8 THEN '0.70-0.79'
    WHEN confidence < 0.9 THEN '0.80-0.89'
    ELSE '0.90+'
  END as conf_bucket,
  COUNT\(*\) as cnt,
  ROUND\(100.0 * COUNT\(*\) / 1511, 1\) as pct
FROM labels 
WHERE teacher LIKE '%gemma%'
GROUP BY conf_bucket
ORDER BY conf_bucket;
")
